reviewer: Independent Codex vision review (motion/character creative reskin)

projection.note: All eight views retain the same elevated front/top reading and coherent turning; no isometric diamond base or changed camera is introduced.

complete-art.note: Hair, hands, boots and every complete silhouette fit the fixed frames; light/dark placements reveal no clipped extremities.

anchor-placement.note: The rear-view heels and entire boot/support region sit visibly lower than the authored ground reference. This is more than forward toe extension: the stored cross meets the boot shafts rather than the original support center.

same-character.note: The eight turns preserve brown shaped hair, blue tunic, dark trousers, bracers and brown cuffed boots. Back views show the back rather than a second front-facing character.

direction-height.note: The standing design has visibly expanded relative to the supplied nominal-height rig: the crown rises and the legs/boots extend downward. The side/front comparisons do not establish the requested common nominal standing scale.

direction-contact.note: Heel/support positions are displaced below the common ground location, also visible from behind where shoe toes cannot explain the shift. A fixed metadata root does not repair this contact.

cutout.note: Processed light/dark views have clean transparent surroundings and no calibration tile or guide strokes.

source-faithfulness.note: The delivered frames retain the source redesign and its scale/contact defects. Declared fixed rectangles, common sampling scale and global alpha32 cleanup do not fit individual subjects or stencil their silhouettes.
